description: Defines a custom Android view class 'HeroCard' which extends CardView. This class creates a fixed-size, focusable card intended for use in a hero banner row, with a title text that can be set programmatically.

classes.name: HeroCard
classes.description: A custom CardView component designed for use within a hero banner, featuring a title and fixed dimensions suitable for TV navigation.

methods.name: HeroCard
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HeroCard view, setting layout, background, focusability, and adding a centered TextView for the title.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the display text of the title TextView inside the HeroCard.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Utility method converting density-independent pixels (dp) to actual pixel units.
